implementation: Apple corecrypto Module [Apple ARM, Secure Key Store, Hardware, SL2] (c_asm)
description: Cryptographic library offering various cryptographic mechanisms to Apple frameworks in the Secure Enclave Processor environment. The following cipher implementation is covered: Generic C non-optimized block mode with assembler AES implementation.
